## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks (`sdh-spot-check`), D = 0: electron n = +3.2×10¹², hole n = −1.2×10¹²

Raw R(B) first, then `sdh_onset` + FFT against the tetralayer model (F_L = (h/4e)·n at the run-5 calibration, **scale not yet pinned**). Run 6's grid is 50 mT below 1 T (Nyquist 2.5 T there), so its onset/FFT floor is 1.0 T; run 7 is 20 mT uniform.

**Read — electron (run 6):** strong oscillations, R from ~15 Ω (1–3 T) up to 530 Ω (quantum-Hall-like minima near 0 Ω at 6.0 and 7.2 T; a step to ~500 Ω above 7.8 T). The tones are **7.3, 14.9, 22.4, 29.4 T** (plus 37, 44, 59 T above ~2–4 T). `sdh_onset` flags 14.9 / 22.4 / 29.4 T as harmonics (2×, 3×, 4×) of 7.3 T. The 7.3 T tone is **censored** at the 1.0 T record edge: it is still alive where the fine grid starts. **The harmonic reading is not safe here.** 7.3 + 22.4 = 29.7 ≈ 29.4 T, so if 29.4 T is F_L, the pair closes the Luttinger sum at a single global scale ≈ 0.90, inside the ~0.8–1.2 lever-arm band. At scale 0.90 the ABAB model puts its pair at 6.6 / 23.2 T and ABCA at 29.8 T. The model's heavy/light ratio at this density is 3.5, while the measured one is 3.07: this is exactly the investigation's warning case ("the ABAB ratio drifts through 3× … a ratio-only screen eats the real heavy tone"). The 29.4 T tone gets stronger at high B (the dominant peak in the 3–10 T window, secondary in 1.2–3 T). That is the pattern expected of a breakdown sum-tone, but a heavier Dingle/LK envelope does the same, so it is **not yet decisive**. **One density cannot separate** {ABAB pair + breakdown sum-tone} from {7.3 T fundamental + comb, plus an F_L singleton}. The tones' **n-dependence** separates them: across n = 1.8 → 3.2×10¹² the model's heavy tone moves 15.7 → 25.9 T while 3 × light moves 8.8 → 22.2 T and F_L moves 18.6 → 33.1 T.

**Read — hole (run 7):** clean, low-onset oscillations: the dominant 6.8 T tone is still alive at the 0.5 T analysis floor (censored). The 12.3 T tone (≈ F_L) dominates above 3 T; weaker tones sit at 4.6, 8.5 and 15.8 T. But the hole side of the D = 0 line reaches only −1.27×10¹², which is the **low-|n| exception regime**: the ABAB pair there is 5.9 / 6.5 T, 0.7 T apart. Separating it needs a 1/B record ≳ 2/0.7 ≈ 2.9 T⁻¹ (onset ≲ 0.33 T), and this record's δF is ≈ 0.5 T. **Not decisive by construction.**

**Take:** both sides are alive and oscillating. The fan goes on the **electron side**, the only side whose D = 0 densities reach the separating regime (|n| ≳ 2×10¹²). Its job is to follow each tone across density.

"""Runs 6 (electron, n = +3.2e12) + 7 (hole, n = -1.2e12): sdh-spot-check read — raw R(B), onset, FFT vs model, B-window split."""
import sys, warnings
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.home() / "measurement_env/hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count"))
import fs_count_b0 as M
# run 6 is 50 mT-stepped below 1 T (Nyquist 2.5 T at 0.5 T) -> analysis floor 1.0 T; run 7 is 20 mT uniform -> floor 0.5 T
spots = {6: dict(n12=+3.2, b_lo=1.0), 7: dict(n12=-1.2, b_lo=0.5)}
fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(13, 8))
for j, (rid, sp) in enumerate(spots.items()):
    r_ = run(rid); B = r_.col("magnet_field"); R = r_.col("sr1_X") / (r_.col("sr0_X") / -1e6)   # device card: sr1 gain 1, sr0 gain -1e6
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R = B[o], R[o]
    n_si = sp["n12"] * 1e16; FL = float(luttinger_frequency(n_si))
    abm = M.abab_mstar(n_si); ac = M.abca_mstar(n_si)
    print(f"=== run {rid}: n = {sp['n12']:+.1f}e12 (D = 0), F_L = {FL:.1f} T | model ABAB (F, m*) = "
          f"{[(round(float(F),1), round(float(m),3)) for F, m in abm]}, ABCA = ({float(ac[0]):.1f}, {float(ac[1]):.3f}) | R {R.min():.0f}..{R.max():.0f} Ohm (FS 5000)")
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        on = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=50e-6 / 10e-9, b_lo=sp["b_lo"])
    print(on.summary()); [print("  note:", str(x.message)[:160]) for x in w]
    axs[0, j].plot(B, R, lw=0.7); axs[0, j].axvline(on.onset_b, color="r", ls="--", lw=0.8, label=f"onset_b {on.onset_b:.2f} T")
    axs[0, j].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="Rxx (Ohm)", title=f"run {rid} raw — n = {sp['n12']:+.1f}e12, D = 0"); axs[0, j].legend(fontsize=8)
    wins = [(sp["b_lo"] if rid == 7 else 1.2, 10.0), (sp["b_lo"] if rid == 7 else 1.2, 3.0), (3.0, 10.0)]
    for br in wins:
        f, s = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=br, bg_degree=5, nfft=16384, log=False); s = s[0] / s[0].max()
        pk, _ = find_peaks(s, prominence=0.08); top = sorted([p for p in pk if f[p] > 2], key=lambda p: -s[p])[:6]
        print(f"  FFT B {br}: dF = {1/(1/br[0]-1/br[1]):.2f} T; peaks (F, rel) {sorted((round(float(f[p]),1), round(float(s[p]),2)) for p in top)}")
        axs[1, j].plot(f, s, lw=0.8, label=f"B {br[0]:.1f}-{br[1]:.0f} T")
    for F, m in abm: axs[1, j].axvline(float(F), color="g", ls=":", lw=1.2)
    axs[1, j].axvline(FL, color="k", ls="--", lw=1, label=f"F_L {FL:.1f} T (= ABCA)")
    axs[1, j].set(xlim=(0, 2.2 * FL), xlabel="F (T)", ylabel="|FFT| (norm.)", title=f"run {rid} FFT (green dotted: ABAB model, scale 1)"); axs[1, j].legend(fontsize=7)
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side, D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`, `tetralayer-stacking-fs-count` Step 4)

> **05:26** · landau-fan-vti e-side D=0: n +3.22->+1.80e12 (31), B 1.0->10 T uniform 1/B (103 rows, d(1/B) 0.0088), sr1 50 uV, fast\_delay 2.1 s; ends 10 T, gates 0 · **ETA ~08:46** (≈3h20m)

**Why this fan.** The spot checks (ana, runs 6–7) found oscillations on both sides but leave the call open. At n = +3.2×10¹² the tones are 7.3 / 14.9 / 22.4 / 29.4 T. The helper reads that as a harmonic comb of 7.3 T, but 7.3 + 22.4 ≈ 29.4 closes a Luttinger sum at scale ≈ 0.90, so the same peaks fit two readings: an ABAB pair plus a breakdown sum-tone, or a 7.3 T fundamental plus an F_L singleton. This is the investigation's "ratio ≈ 3" trap. Only **n-dependence** resolves it. Over this window the model's heavy tone moves 15.7 → 26.0 T, while 3 × light moves 8.8 → 22.3 T and F_L moves 18.6 → 33.3 T (scale 1), so the trajectories separate. The hole side stays capped at −1.27×10¹², where the ABAB pair is 0.7 T apart and cannot be resolved (ana), so the fan goes on the **electron side**.

**Design (computed; `landau-fan` step-1 checks).** n = +3.22 → +1.80×10¹² at D = 0 (run-5 calibration). The top end sits 11 mV under the TG limit. The bottom end is where the heavy-vs-F_L split (≈ 2.6 T) still clears ~2·δF. **B_lo = 1.0 T**: `sdh_onset` on run 6 gives 1.0 T, but that is censored at the record edge, because the 7.3 T tone is still alive where the 10 mT grid starts. The heavy/F_L tones start at 1.2–1.8 T. **B_hi = 10 T** keeps a long high-B half for the F_L-tone origin B-window split (the 29 T tone grows with B in run 6). **Slow axis: uniform in 1/B, 103 rows, Δ(1/B) = 0.0088 T⁻¹.** That is 1/3 of the fastest expected tone, 37.7 T, the region-B mosaic F_L (n + 0.43×10¹²) at scale 1. δF = 1.11 T. **Fast axis: 31 points, Δn = 0.047×10¹²**, which is 2 samples per LL ray at B_lo (the floor). **Dynamic range:** sr1 is fixed at 50 µV = 5 kΩ FS, inherited from the spot checks. The worst corner is n = 1.8 at 10 T: R(0) = 77 Ω (run 5) × an MR factor ≲ 20, i.e. ≲ 1.5 kΩ, leaving ≥ 3× headroom. A near-rail counter prints if it's wrong. **Settling:** τ = 0.3 s at 24 dB/oct is asserted. fast_delay = 2.1 s = 7τ (the rig-card floor); 3 s after each flyback. **Price:** grid 103 × 31 × 2.2 s/pt (run 6: 0.08 s reads per point) = 117 min, plus 0 → 10 T ramp 73 min, plus per-row turnaround ~7 s × 103 = 12 min, ≈ 3 h 20 m. Ends at **10 T, gates parked at 0**. The next step (the LK mass split) rides the field down. **Coverage trade:** n < 1.8×10¹² and the sub-1 T record are excluded. Below 1.8 the light tone is < 3 T and unresolvable, and heavy vs F_L merges within 2δF. Adding 0.6–1 T would cost ~70 rows ≈ +1.5 h for a record where only the light tone lives.

**Checkpoints.** (1) **First rows** (~9 min in, B ≈ 1.0 T): R across n ≈ 15–80 Ω, sr0 ≈ 9.9 nA, gate currents at the pA floor, no rail. (2) **B ≈ 2 T, row 57, ~1 h 25 m in:** per-column FFT on the 1–2 T record. The ~7 T light tone must appear in the high-n columns (run 6 had it at SNR ~100) and should move with n. If there is no oscillation content anywhere, abort: calibration or contacts have broken, and continuing costs 2 h. (3) **B ≈ 3.4 T, row 80, ~2 h 05 m in:** the n = 3.2 column must reproduce run 6's 22 / 29 T pair (shared-density check). Early read of the heavy-vs-F_L trajectories.

# === Landau fan, electron side, D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti` / tetralayer-stacking-fs-count Step 4) ===
# Slow: magnet.field uniform in 1/B, 1.0 -> 10.0 T, 103 rows (d(1/B) = 0.00882 T^-1).  Fast: paired (Vtg, Vbg) n-line at D = 0,
# n = +3.22 -> +1.80e12, 31 pts (dn = 0.047e12).  Fixed sr1 50 uV (5 kOhm FS), tau 0.3 s / 24 dB, fast_delay 2.1 s (7 tau).
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD
# --- session calibration, run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, absolute scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
N_HI, N_LO, N_N, D0 = 3.22, 1.80, 31, 0.0
B_LO, B_HI, N_B = 1.0, 10.0, 103
ns = np.linspace(N_HI, N_LO, N_N); Ds = D0 * np.ones(N_N)
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, Ds, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
Vtgs, Vbgs = np.round(Vtgs, 5), np.round(Vbgs, 5)
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vtgs.min(), Vtgs.max(), Vbgs.min(), Vbgs.max())
B_vec = field_invB(B_LO, B_HI, N_B)
assert B_vec.min() > 0 and B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
nr, Dr = calc_nD(Vtgs, Vbgs, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
print(f"fast: n {ns[0]:+.3f} -> {ns[-1]:+.3f}e12 ({N_N} pts, dn {ns[0]-ns[1]:.4f}); Vtg {Vtgs[0]:+.4f} -> {Vtgs[-1]:+.4f}, Vbg {Vbgs[0]:+.4f} -> {Vbgs[-1]:+.4f}; "
      f"roundtrip max|D| {np.abs(Dr).max():.1e}")
print(f"slow: B {B_vec[0]:.3f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.3f} T, {N_B} rows uniform 1/B, d(1/B) = {1/B_vec[0]-1/B_vec[1]:.5f} T^-1 "
      f"(Nyquist {1/(2*(1/B_vec[0]-1/B_vec[1])):.1f} T)")
# --- preconditions (state this cell assumes but does not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _Tv, _B0 = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field()
_tau, _slope = sr1.time_constant(), sr1.filter_slope()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), T_vap = {_Tv:.3f} K, B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"heater ranges {heater.sample_range()}/{heater.vaporizer_range()} (0/0), PS {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, "
      f"sr1 tau {_tau} s slope {_slope} dB (0.3/24: dwell priced on it), nplci {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5, f"T_sample {_T0} off base"
assert abs(_B0) < 0.05, f"magnet not at 0: {_B0}"
assert abs(k_si()) < 0.01, "Si gate not at 0"
assert heater.sample_range() == 0 and heater.vaporizer_range() == 0, "a heater is on"
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert _tau == 0.3 and _slope == 24, f"lock-in settling changed: tau {_tau}, slope {_slope}"
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
# --- fixed acquisition (inherited from spot checks runs 6/7): sr1 50 uV = 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA; sr0 20 mV ---
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6); sr0.sensitivity(20e-3)
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 2.1, 3.0          # 7 tau at 24 dB/oct per point; 10 tau after each flyback (+ the driver's 3 s field settle)
I_TRIP = 1e-9
print(f"drive {sr1.amplitude()} V -> {sr1.amplitude()/100e6*1e9:.1f} nA; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V; sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V; settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s")
mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan-vti electron D=0: n {N_HI:+.2f} -> {N_LO:+.2f}e12 ({N_N}), B {B_LO} -> {B_HI} T uniform 1/B ({N_B} rows), "
                  f"sr1 50 uV, fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, cal run 5")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'D = {D0} V/nm, n = {N_LO} to {N_HI} e12 cm^-2 ({N_N} pts), B = {B_LO} to {B_HI} T uniform in 1/B ({N_B} rows, d(1/B) {1/B_vec[0]-1/B_vec[1]:.5f}); '
              f'tetralayer-stacking-fs-count Step 4 (electron side); cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.4f}e12, '
              f'D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; sr1 50 uV, tau 0.3 s/24 dB, fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s')
# --- position: gates to the first fan point, magnet 0 -> 1.0 T (blocking, ~7.5 min) ---
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0])
magnet.field(B_vec[0])
print(f"positioned: B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K")
# row layout: [time, B, Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)
_rail = {"n": 0}
def leak_and_rail_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f}, Vbg={float(data[3]):+.4f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
    if abs(float(data[9])) > 0.95 * 50e-6:
        _rail["n"] += 1
        if _rail["n"] in (1, 10, 100):
            print(f"sr1 near rail (#{_rail['n']}) at B={float(data[1]):.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f}: X={float(data[9]):.3e} V")
s.register_run_after(leak_and_rail_guard, ())
try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs], slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
    print(f"end: B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T (held: next step rides it down), gates parked ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), "
          f"T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K, sr1 near-rail points = {_rail['n']}")

## HERA — Step 3: SdH spot check, electron side (`sdh-spot-check`), n = +3.2×10¹² at D = 0, B 0 → 10 T

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)

Calibration from run 5 (ana): c_bg/c_tg = 0.773 (data), c_tg = 2.796 mF/m² (9.5 nm prior), n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm (R_CNP(D) symmetry). mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = f"sdh-spot-check hole: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm (run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 10 -> 0.3 T, 20 mT, sr1 50 uV"
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)

s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field ends at 0.3 T — no park here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
